function webhook(text,color)
	if webhookurl == "" then

		text = tostring(text)

			col = color
		end
		local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
		if tagperson ~= "<@USERIDHERE>" then
			local s = request({
				Url = webhookurl,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
				},
				Body = http:JSONEncode({
					["content"] = tagperson,
					["embeds"] = {{
						["title"] = text,
						["description"] = text,
						["type"] = "rich",
						["color"] = col

				},

function breakvel() -- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source thanks!
	local BeenASecond, V3 = false, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	delay(1, function()
		BeenASecond = true
	end)
	while not BeenASecond do
		for _, v in ipairs(localplr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				v.Velocity, v.RotVelocity = V3, V3
			end
		end
		wait()
	end
end
